<p>Live like a local. For families or a group of friends who like to be independents.</p>
<div class="icon-stars-container"><svg></svg><!-- <i class="fas fa-star"></i> Font Awesome fontawesome.com --><svg></svg><!-- <i class="fas fa-star"></i> Font Awesome fontawesome.com --><svg></svg><!-- <i class="fas fa-star"></i> Font Awesome fontawesome.com --><svg></svg><!-- <i class="fas fa-star"></i> Font Awesome fontawesome.com --></div></div>

First of all because you will feel comfortable and at home. Second, we have chosen superb homes that can be rented at the surf site, or just seven minutes away on a picturesque beach under the palm trees. Best of all, the greatest north Peruvian dishes will be prepared for you by a chef, making every meal an unforgettable experience.</span></i></p></div>

<li>Choose between two locations: 1. Close to the village and surf/kite spot 2. On a most paradisiacal beach.</li>
<li>Have a personal chef and a cleaning service.</li>
<li>Different price ranges, varying from USD 300 to USD 1500 per night.</li>
<li>Up to 5 rooms.</li>
</ul></div>

<li>Cleaning service</li>
<li>Various bedrooms</li>
<li>Fans or AC</li>
